segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ עִיר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה — חוּצָה לָהּ מוּתָּר, הָיָה חוּצָה לָהּ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה — תּוֹכָהּ לָהּ מוּתָּר. מַהוּ לֵילֵךְ לְשָׁם? בִּזְמַן שֶׁהַדֶּרֶךְ מְיוּחֶדֶת לְאוֹתוֹ מָקוֹם — אָסוּר, וְאִם הָיָה יָכוֹל לְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ לְמָקוֹם אַחֵר — מוּתָּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «a city in which there is» active «idol worship,» it is «permitted» to engage in business transactions with gentiles who live «outside of» the city. If the «idol worship» is «outside» the city, it is «permitted» to engage in business «within» the city. «What is» the halakha with regard to «traveling there,» a place where a pagan festival is being celebrated? «When the road is designated» only «for that place,» it is «prohibited» to use the road, as onlookers will assume that the traveler intends to join the festival. «But if one were able to travel on it to» arrive at «another place,» it is «permitted» to use the road to reach the place that is observing the festival.

moves.summary: forbidden if the road leads only there

positions.claim: a road designated only for the idolatrous place is forbidden; a through-road is permitted
